create_StructureStore_from_directory: create a StructureStore from a directory path to retrieve mmCIF files by target name
create_StructureStore_from_mapping: create a StructureStore from a mapping of target names to mmCIF strings
create_StructureStore_from_tar: create a StructureStore from a tar archive containing mmCIF files
get_mmcif_str: get the mmCIF string for a given target name from the StructureStore
list_target_names: list all target names available in the StructureStore
